name: Sixfold Shot spends its five stacks and shows its Transform buff (#1453)
contract: Sixfold Shot 500567 (level 50 passive, family 21) reads 'Every 5th Darkslayer or Shadowblast now transforms your Quickdraw into Sixfold Shot'. Its stack buff 500569 (StackAmount 5, 15 s) has the tooltip 'At 5 stacks your Quickdraw is transformed into Sixfold Shot' and its Transform buff 500604 (StackAmount 1, 15 s) has the tooltip 'Your next Quickdraw has transformed into Sixfold Shot!'. So one Sixfold Shot is earned per five bolts and the cast spends it: afterwards Quickdraw is back and Sixfold Shot is refused until five more bolts. The client's SpellActivationOverlays.dbc row 888 lights the Sixfold Shot 807364 button on TRIGGER_TYPE_AURA_EXISTS of 500604, so the glow needs the server to apply 500604 at five stacks; nothing applied it. Sixfold Shot 807364 carries SPELL_ATTR4_ALLOW_CAST_WHILE_CASTING, which makes every cast of it carry TRIGGERED_IGNORE_CAST_IN_PROGRESS | TRIGGERED_CAST_DIRECTLY, so Spell::IsTriggered() is true for the player's own cast: the five-stack check in OnSpellCheckCast and the stack removal after the cast were both skipped, and the shot could be repeated. The scenario builds the stacks with Shadowblast 680264 (instant, flags C 0x10), checks the Transform buff and the Quickdraw 804193 replacement, fires Sixfold Shot once (six 807527 hits, ranged hit fixture-maxed so a miss cannot hide them), then checks the stacks, buff and replacement are gone and a second Sixfold Shot is refused with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE (22) and deals nothing.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Let the weapon swap cooldown expire
Sixfold Shot is not known before the stacks
No Transform buff below five stacks
#1453: the fifth bolt applies the Transform buff that lights the button
Quickdraw is transformed into Sixfold Shot
#1453: the cast spends the five stacks
#1453: the cast spends the Transform buff
#1453: Quickdraw is back on its button
Let the channel and its global cooldown end
Try a second Sixfold Shot without stacks
#1453: the second Sixfold Shot is refused
